tooltip.curiouschests.bottomless.lore_1: Born in darkness beneath ancient waters.
tooltip.curiouschests.bottomless.lore_2: Its depth knows no bottom — only a price.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.lore_1: Forged where stone melts without flame.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.lore_2: The furnace within never asks for fuel.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.ability: Smelts items; overflow is ejected in front.
tooltip.curiouschests.ender_dispatch.lor: It remembers every storehouse it has seen.
Yet it belongs to none of them.
tooltip.curiouschests.builders.lore_1: A true builder never reaches twice for a block.
tooltip.curiouschests.builders.lore_2: The chest listens for an empty hand.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.lore_1: Roots beneath it hear every fallen trinket.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.lore_2: Nothing nearby remains forgotten for long.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.ability: Pulls dropped items from within 8 blocks.
